name: PerfMon
tagline: Windows 11 Task Manager & Precision Telemetry Suite
short_description: A high-performance Windows 11 Task Manager for Mac. Features unified sortable, resizable, and reorderable table columns across all views, modular sub-second desktop HUD widgets (per-disk & network breakouts, process-locked hierarchy trees), custom Menu Bar item builder with PM monogram icon, interactive 3-column Disk Access & Network Connection Flow Maps with 1-click process isolation, hardware bus monitoring (USB/TB/PCIe), and Apple Silicon GPU telemetry.
spotlight_description: Everything you love about the Windows 11 Task Manager, engineered natively for macOS in Swift 6. Version 1.3 adds unified sortable, resizable, and drag-to-reorder table columns across every telemetry view, alongside sub-second desktop HUD widgets, modular custom widget builder (break out specific disks, network adapters, and process trees with restart-safe PID invariance), custom Menu Bar item builder with PM monogram icon & color styling, interactive 3-column Disk Access Topology Map with file I/O isolation, Network Connection Flow Map with reverse DNS & cloud badges, Apple Silicon GPU telemetry, and privacy-first opt-in local telemetry.
catalog_description: A high-performance Windows 11 Task Manager recreation engineered natively in Swift 6 for macOS. Features unified sortable, resizable, and reorderable table columns across all 7 telemetry tables, near real-time modular desktop widgets (0.5s–1s sampling, specific disk & network adapter breakouts, process-locked hierarchy trees), custom Menu Bar item builder with PM monogram icon & color styling, interactive 3-column Disk Access & Network Connection Topology Flow Maps with 1-click process isolation, hardware bus monitoring (USB/Thunderbolt/PCIe), 60-second rolling CoreGraphics/Metal grid waveforms, and privacy-first opt-in on-device telemetry. Zero external dependencies.
